prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Premium supplement tin, Round lift-off box. A separate round cap fits over a cylindrical rigid base. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Textured uncoated wrapping paper, Terracotta and cream, Fine foil lines and offset pattern, restrained botanical line drawing. EMPTY insert: one cylindrical container well. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: Detached round lid flat beside circular base with clear gap. Both perfectly round, NO hinge. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
